text:
The satellite data indicate **0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2024**, spread across patches smaller than 0.5 hectares. Those patches were below the minimum size used to count a corroborated loss event, so the evidence does not establish a corroborated event for 2024.

A separate 0.7-hectare loss event was corroborated in 2023. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation or its cause.
